title: autolink_bare_urls uses byte-level anchor detection that can miss edge cases
description: src/posting.rs:508-555. autolink_bare_urls() scans for '<a ' at byte positions to split HTML into anchor/non-anchor segments, then linkifies non-anchor segments. The detection checks bytes[i+2] for space or '>' but doesn't handle cases like '<a\n' (newline after tag name) or '<A ' (uppercase). In practice pulldown-cmark and ammonia always produce lowercase '<a ' so this is correct for the actual input domain, but the implicit dependency on upstream output format is fragile. A comment noting this would help.
